title: Heavy rain hits southern Thailand as western reservoirs reach 96%

blocks.text: BANGKOK — Reservoirs in western Thailand were at 96% of storage capacity on Sunday (Oct. 11), as heavy rain affected southern and western parts of the country, with Yala province recording 137 millimeters (mm) of rainfall and Phetchaburi 126 mm, according to the Office of the National Water Resources (ONWR). The country’s reservoirs held a combined 65.9 billion cubic meters of water, equivalent to 82% of total storage capacity, the ONWR reported at 7 a.m. Usable water reserves stood at 41.8 billion cubic meters, or 74% of usable storage capacity.
